segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I wanted to confirm the expansion for the calibration management workspace: 38 technician seats, 6 manager seats, and the certificate import add-on, all starting March 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that matches my notes. We also need the two Anaheim lab supervisors included in the manager seats, not as techs.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I have them listed as managers. The annual total is $41,760 before tax, billed on invoice with net 30 terms. Same billing contact, ap@northlakeprecision.com?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Same contact. Can you split the invoice by location, though? Chicago is 24 techs and 4 managers, Anaheim is 14 techs and 2 managers.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can show that allocation on the invoice. It’ll still be one contract and one payment schedule, but the location breakdown will be on the billing detail.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that works. For go-live, we’re aiming March 18. Is that realistic if we sign this week?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If we have signature by Friday, kickoff would be March 4, data import on March 7, admin training March 12, and tech training March 14. That gives you a few days to check the instrument records before the 18th.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. The only other thing is we need historical certs for 2023 and 2024 loaded, not just the open items.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included. I’ll put that in the order notes: import completed and archived calibration certificates from January 1, 2023 through current, for both locations.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send the order form to me and Luis for signature. If it’s the $41,760 and those dates are in there, we should be able to turn it around tomorrow.
